mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Honest core: the engine CAN express the reactive half — enemy damage -> on-damage-taken -> linked-cast, plus RETRIBUTION_ENGINE — a damage-taken proc chassis. It canNOT express the CLOSED loop: the kit's own summon -> instant minion death -> flat self-damage re-ENTERING the trigger as its condition. MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 is LOCKED (source depth is cyclic/unbounded — a depth mint is template-forbidden); there is no minion-death -> self-damage lane and no self-hit primitive (b04 forbidden-rite steward precedent: hp_cost_scale is a COST, it does not feed damage-taken triggers). Eras ERRATA-corrected at ingest-4 (Ward debuts 3.15; 3.14 floor removed).
